title: Accuracy regression in DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B after upgrading Transformers from 4.55 to 5.9
author: xiaowangintel

comments.author: xiaowangintel
comments.body: The tokenizer_config.json of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B specifies LlamaTokenizerFast. However, in Transformers 5.9, the definition file for LlamaTokenizerFast was removed, causing the tokenizer to fall back to LlamaTokenizer by default. Will there be any future updates or maintenance for DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B?

comments.author: itazap
comments.body: will be fixed by https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/46091 will comment soon when its merged

comments.author: xiaowangintel
comments.body: Closing the issue, as the problem has already been fixed.
